headline: 17 L1 Ethereum contracts and 17 L2 Ink predeploys catalogued from official docs; ProxyAdmin and all core OP-Stack bridge contracts identified on Ethereum mainnet.

rationale.verdict: Discovery run walked the official inkonchain.com website, the docs contracts page, and Etherscan for the L1StandardBridge. 13 named L1 Ethereum contracts and 17 Ink L2 predeploys were catalogued from the official docs; the Etherscan bridge page confirmed the proxy structure and revealed the L1CrossDomainMessenger address via internal transactions. No audit PDFs or GitHub deployment artifacts were fetched this run.

protocol_metadata.about: Ink Bridge is the canonical OP-Stack bridge for the Ink network, an Ethereum Layer 2 blockchain built by Kraken on the Optimism Superchain framework. Users deposit ETH or ERC-20 tokens from Ethereum mainnet into the L1StandardBridge, which locks assets on L1 while minting equivalent representations on Ink L2 via the L2StandardBridge predeploy. Withdrawals from Ink to Ethereum go through a fault-proof challenge period (permissionless fault proofs were live at launch, with Gelato and Kraken operating fault-proof challengers). The system is governed by OP-Stack contracts including ProxyAdmin, SystemConfig, DisputeGameFactory, and OptimismPortal on Ethereum mainnet.
